name: Daily SSOP Inspection
description: Pre-op, operational and post-op sanitation checks by area. Mark ✱ wherever something needs attention and write the comment or corrective action on that line.

fields.label: 1. Pre-Op
fields.hint: Tap a box once for ✓, twice for ✱ (needs attention), three times to clear. Shaded boxes don't apply to that area.

items.label: Inspect equipment, FCS, and utensils for cleanliness.
Inspect utensils and containers for cracks or chips.
Inspect floors, walls, doors, and ceilings for cleanliness.
ATP swabs performed?
Cold storage: temperature within acceptable range? Check for icing/condensation. No items stored underneath cooler fans or hoses.
Test food-contact sanitizer strength. QUAT: 200-400 ppm (strip). PAA: 90-190 ppm (Kemio).
Sink is working. Soap, paper towels, hand sanitizer available. Trash cans empty with new liners.
Floor mats and door ways to high-risk areas contain floor powder sanitizer. Foot foamer system on and working.
Verify accuracy of monitoring equipment/devices (metal detector, X-ray, pH meter, scales).
Are clean and used smock racks thoroughly covered with a plastic lining to prevent contamination?
Start up equipment and inspect for damage. Report any damage to maintenance or Management.
Ingredients, WIP, packaging materials, utensils, tools, and finished products are properly labeled and/or stored. Ingredients and WIP are enclosed/covered when not in use in warehouse.
Handwashing: employees washing hands before entering work area. Sink is working. Soap, paper towels, hand sanitizer full.
GMP: PPE being worn and changed properly. No jewelry being worn.
Check toilet facilities. Area cleaned. Sink is working. Soap, paper towels, toilet paper available.
Chemicals are properly labeled. Utensils in processing area are stored in sanitizer when not in use.

Ingredients, WIP, packaging materials, utensils, tools, and finished products are properly labelled, stored, and/or used within time constraints. Ingredients and WIP are enclosed/covered when not in use in warehouse.
Dispose trash and unused materials from area.
Cold storage: temperature within acceptable range? Check for icing/condensation. No items stored underneath cooler fans or hoses.
Doors are closed when not in use. Check for any sign of pests.
Inspect utensils and containers for cracks or chips. Inspect bags of product being used. Check for seepage, tears, rips, improper opening of bags by employees, etc.
Inspect all equipment for damage during operation. Report any damage to maintenance or management.

Ingredients, WIP, packaging, utensils, tools, and finished products are properly labelled, stored, and/or used within time constraints. Ingredients and WIP are enclosed/covered when not in use in warehouse.
Shutdown all equipment. Equipment disassembled, cleaned, and sanitized.
Inspect equipment, FCS, and utensils for cleanliness before sanitizing.
Inspect floors, walls, doors, and ceilings for cleanliness before sanitizing. Squeegee all water from the floor.
Doors are closed. Check for any sign of pests.
Dispose trash in the proper receptacle. Trash cans empty and clean. Store squeegees in sanitizer.
